description: This file contains the implementation of a NewtonsoftJsonCodec class used for JSON serialization and deserialization within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It also includes options configuration and extension methods for integrating Newtonsoft.Json serializer into the serialization builder.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
classes.description: A codec class for serializing and deserializing objects to and from JSON using Newtonsoft.Json within Orleans.Serialization.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the NewtonsoftJsonCodec, including settings and type support predicates.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an object. Currently unimplemented (throws null).

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported for copying.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of a specified type from a buffer reader.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a field to a buffer writer with a specified field ID delta, expected type, and value.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a type is allowed by the type filter.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported by the general JSON codec.

methods.name: AddNewtonsoftJsonSerializer
methods.description: Extension methods to add Newtonsoft.Json serializer to the Orleans serialization builder, with options for support predicate and serializer settings.
